create_ObbTW_from_lmc: create an ObbTW oriented 3D bounding box from 3D box, 2D projections, pose, and semantic IDs
compute_obb_iou3d: compute the 3D intersection over union between two batches of oriented bounding boxes using voxel sampling
project_bb3d_onto_image: project 3D oriented bounding box corners into a 2D image plane given a camera and world-to-rig pose
transform_obbs: transform padded oriented bounding boxes from world coordinates to another coordinate system using a SE3 transform
filter_obbs_by_sem_id: filter an ObbTW collection to keep only bounding boxes matching specified semantic class IDs
